prompt: ONE original tall 1290:2796 portrait production wallpaper for Glaze ENAMEL RELIQUARY. A physical furnace-fired CLOISONNE ENAMEL FOSSIL MOSAIC: macro photograph looking straight down on an enormous matte blackened burgundy copper plate whose lower half contains fractured cross-sections of completely imaginary extinct lifeforms. Hair-thin uneven raised brass wires separate pools of molten opaque and translucent enamel, pooled turquoise, sulphur yellow, tangerine and oxblood; little firing bubbles, orange-peel pits, crazing and occasional black scorched copper edges make the kiln process unmistakable. Lower-left a broad split three-pronged fossil cross-section opens into chambers; lower-right a ladder-like ribbon fossil is cut diagonally and several fan ridges radiate through the mosaic, separated by broad dark negative spaces. Feels like a jeweller fired a geological map of an invented lost biosphere, NOT conventional dinosaur bones, shell collection, stained-glass window or polished gemstones. Flat shallow relief, extreme tactile macro material detail, controlled sharp glints rather than 3D creatures. Upper 45% remains quiet near-black plum #261422 with subtle scorched metal patina and only a few hairline brass seams for phone readability. Palette #261422, brass #CF9A48, turquoise #4BC1B0, sulphur #E5CC58, orange #D86C3F. No words, letters, numerals, labels, symbols, clock hands/dials, dates, battery readings, UI, logos, border, mockup or collage. One continuous crafted wallpaper.
processing: Wallpaper: fit to 1290x2796. Artwork: fit entire original to 840px inside transparent 1024px canvas, no crop/recolour/subject edits; alpha retained.
